differences: Experiment 1 file: 99 participants; the paper reports 110 tested, 18 excluded and 92 analysed (the script excludes 7 of the 99), so 11 of the excluded participants are not in the file.
Experiment 2 file: 87 participants (the paper tested 95 and analysed 87); the other 8 are not in the file.

Experiment 1 has two pairs of rows with the same participant, condition and trial number (kept as shared), so one participant has 25 ambiguous Canonical rows in one condition although the design has 24 trials.

Tables 2 and 4 were refitted in Python (REML with the random-effect terms the authors name, Powell optimizer); coefficients, SEs and t agree with the printed values to the printed decimals (t within 0.03); p-values were not refitted. One exception: the Experiment 2 post-hoc t of Test Stimulus F0 x Statistical Regularity in the Mixed: Match condition refits to 8.13 where the paper prints 8.18 (the random-effect estimates of the two programs differ slightly).
